extracted.name: Cinnamon Apple Syrup
extracted.description: Apples simmered with sugar and cinnamon makes a great sundae topping over vanilla ice cream, or as a pancake topping! Adjust cinnamon and sugar to taste.
ingredient_lines: 2 tart apples - peeled, cored, and sliced
instruction_lines: Combine apples, sugar, cinnamon, and water in a saucepan; stir to dissolve sugar. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low; simmer until apples soft and syrup thickened, 10 minutes. Serve over pancakes or ice cream.
